call.narrative: A bus flipped over! There are so many people, maybe 30 or so, people screaming.

output.rationale: Bus crash with ~30 victims, trapped victims requiring fire to access; police needed for crowd/scene safety. START triage indicates multiple victims with critical/serious closely clustered; scene likely high patient load. First crew reports 2 critical, 11 serious, 16 minor; potential for expectant. Action: multi-agency response warranted; prioritize triage and remote/scene control.
